Gated and merged at c750860. Candidate abdc219, gated merged tree d423c898, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1352 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures. Branch verified as main before merging, per the rule added after I merged onto another agent's branch earlier today.

The defect this closes is worth stating plainly because it is recursive: AnnaFixtureSuite recomputed its expected lemmas through the SAME Lexical.stems call it was checking, so the assertion was invariant under the mutation it exists to catch. The guard protecting this morning's fixture fix was itself vacuous -- exactly rule 4's second vacuity mode, a test that recomputes the formula it is verifying. m1 found it in post-merge review of work it had already independently confirmed once.
